To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the stress in and around the TSVs can be estimated analytically; (2) the stress is significantly reduced by the presence of an oxide layer around the copper via; and (3) the onset of plastic deformation in the copper reduces the stress in the silicon matrix surrounding the TSV.

(a) the stress field in the vicinity of TSVs can be accurately estimated by the analytical model, and the results compare well with those of finite element simulations, (b) the stress field can be reduced by increasing the oxide thickness, (c) the stress can be reduced by decreasing the TSV diameter, (d) the stress can also be reduced by increasing TSV spacing, and (e) the onset of plastic flow in the copper via reduces the stress field in its vicinity
